svg.text: Alchemical apparatus — nested cascade tiers
310 across corners × 660 tall · orange rule = 320 mm bed and footprint · blue = the three nested cascade cones, inner one highest
1. Pelican
belly + two return arms - the vessel that feeds itself
2. Retort
swan neck sweeping off one side - a front and a back
3. Alembic + beak
still-head with a condensing spout, drips to a receiver
4. Tribikos
three-armed still - one belly, three condensing limbs
5. Kerotakis
sealed tower with a condensing shelf - the reflux vessel
6. Aludel
sublimation pots nested mouth-to-mouth, each inside the last
7. Athanor
furnace tower - heavy base, tapering stack, chimney crown
8. Matrass
bolt-head: one true sphere, one long neck. the purest still
9. Cucurbit + cap
squat gourd, domed cap, low and wide - most volume
10. Ampulla
double belly with a pinched waist - two chambers, one throat
